title: Tractatus (Sermons) / «Трактаты» Зинона (Зенона) Веронского
author: Zeno of Verona
size: 93 tractates (16 long, 77 short); PL 11, cols. 253–528; est. 45–50k words
edition: Löfstedt, CCSL 22 (1971). Public domain: Giuliari (1883); Ballerini (1739) = PL 11.
ru_evidence: azbyka.ru lists only 4 short pieces (c. 14k characters) of 93; the pravenc.ru 'Зинон' bibliography (2009) gives no Russian translation
en_evidence: G. Jeanes, The Day Has Come! (Liturgical Press 1995): Easter and baptismal sermons only (Open Library)
other_translations: German: BKV (1934). Italian: Banterle (1987); Città Nuova (2008).
value: An African-born rhetor-bishop writing Apuleian artistic prose: a zodiac sermon for neophytes, attacks on pagan rites, Virgilian echoes, early Christian Verona. A prime source for Christian–classical cultural interaction and late Latin style.
ai_feasibility: medium: mannered, rhythmic Latin with wordplay and textual cruxes. Public-domain text exists.
pilot_unit: Dossier of c. 12 tractates on classical culture and Easter (incl. I.38 on the twelve signs); est. 8–10k words
